sources.body_basis: Exact selected rendered main-content sentences returned by official-page retrieval; short excerpt only, not raw HTML or a full page hash.
implemented_facts: A successful response has a response.completed event with the response object and sequence number.
Text delta/done events identify an item and content position; the completed output contains the final text.
The completion example also exposes reasoning_effort; missing telemetry does not imply the requested effort.

sources.body_basis: Exact selected parameter-schema lines returned by official-page search retrieval; short excerpt only, not raw HTML or a full page hash. Direct page open exceeded the web renderer content-length limit.
implemented_facts: The public Responses effort enum includes high; individual models need not accept every effort value.
The public service tier enum includes default; returned service_tier reports the mode actually used and may differ from the request.
This generic API parameter profile establishes legal requested fields, not own-plan account entitlement or model-specific acceptance.
